queue.contract: android/.gitignore covers key.properties, *.keystore, *.jks, keystore.properties. loop_guard's secret-hygiene check passes. This lands before U0.4 so there is no window in which a signing credential could be staged.

queue.title: Release signing config; produce a genuinely signed AAB
queue.contract: android/app/build.gradle.kts gains a release signingConfig loaded from a gitignored android/key.properties, falling back to debug signing when that file is absent so CI never breaks. flutter build appbundle --release produces an AAB whose signer certificate SHA-256 equals the upload keystore's. verify_aab_signer.sh exits 0.

queue.title: Bundle Outfit, Inter and 9 Noto Sans Indic; remove google_fonts entirely
queue.contract: pubspec.yaml declares >=11 font families as bundled assets; the google_fonts dependency is GONE, making 'no runtime font fetch' enforceable by absence rather than by grep. Noto Serif Indic is deliberately NOT bundled — app_text.dart documents that kIndicSerifFallback is never rendered, so it would double the Indic payload for zero pixels. Expect 2-5 test-expectation adjustments: google_fonts applies its own text-metric overrides and theme_contrast_test.dart asserts against them.

blockedBy.detail: H1 — approve downloading the Outfit / Inter / Noto Sans Indic TTFs (SIL Open Font License) from github.com/google/fonts. Granted by plan approval.

notes: Blocks U0.18: goldens baselined against runtime-fetched fonts capture fallback boxes as the blessed rendering, because flutter test has no network.

queue.title: i18n audit tooling, locked glossary, and per-locale work packets
queue.contract: scripts/loop/i18n_audit.py performs five checks: key parity, script coverage per Unicode block, placeholder parity, ICU plural-category validity, and no-emoji/no-em-dash. GLOSSARY.md is seeded MECHANICALLY by extracting how each product noun was already rendered in the existing 495 translated keys per language — this is what stops ten parallel agents inventing ten words for 'worksheet'. A work-packet extractor emits {key, en, description} JSON per locale so no translation agent ever parses an ARB.
notes: All 971 en keys carry @description metadata — the translation input is unusually good.
Only 40 of the existing 4950 translated values are English-identical, so the script-coverage gate will be near-zero-noise.

queue.title: Hindi pilot translation — 476 keys, one locale, calibration run
queue.contract: app_hi.arb reaches 971 keys, all passing i18n_audit. Run ALONE before the nine-locale fan-out: a tooling or glossary bug found here costs 1x rework instead of 10x. Hindi and Marathi treat 0 as CLDR plural category 'one' — get that right here.

queue.title: Nine-locale translation fan-out: bn gu kn ml mr or pa ta te
queue.contract: Each of the nine remaining Indic ARBs reaches 971 keys passing i18n_audit. Run as a Workflow fan-out — one agent per locale, one file each, no shared state. CRITICALLY: no translation agent runs flutter gen-l10n; nine agents racing on lib/core/i18n/gen/ would corrupt it. Codegen is serialised into U0.9.

queue.title: Sidecar: verify before accept, required env, redacted /readyz
queue.contract: In sahayakai-agents vidya_voice/router.py, move verify_stream_token ABOVE ws.accept() so an unauthenticated caller never gets a WebSocket and no billable Vertex session is allocated. Remove config.py's env default of 'development' — auth.py skips ALL gates in that mode, so a deploy path that forgets SAHAYAKAI_AGENTS_ENV currently serves wide open; without the default it crash-loops on the startup probe instead. Reduce public /readyz to {status:ok}: it currently leaks env, allowedInvokerCount, liveKeyCount and shadowKeyCount. Test must assert genai.Client is NEVER constructed for a rejected token.
notes: The WS bypasses auth entirely today: Starlette's BaseHTTPMiddleware does not wrap websocket ASGI scopes, so the sidecar's OIDC + HMAC + App Check gate never runs on /stream.
Runs in a separate worktree of the monorepo.

queue.title: Sidecar cost control: single-use tokens, concurrency, rate limit, session caps
queue.contract: Single-use stream tokens via a TTLCache (cachetools is already a dependency for the HMAC replay guard — reuse the pattern, add nothing). Per-uid concurrency 1, per-uid hourly rate limit, a global asyncio.Semaphore ceiling, a 600s session wall clock and a 30s idle-input timeout, plus per-session byte accounting. Move the token from ?t= to Authorization: Bearer, accepting ?t= for exactly one release — a credential in a query string lands in Cloud Run access logs.
notes: Must land BEFORE U1.5 merges. Today anyone holding a 120s token can open a billable audio socket repeatedly, concurrently, without limit.

queue.title: Sidecar: env-driven model/location and a teacher-context setup frame
queue.contract: VERTEX_LIVE_MODEL and VERTEX_LIVE_LOCATION become env-driven (they are module constants today, so a region change needs a code deploy) with the proven values as defaults. Accept a first client frame {setup:{grade,subject,schoolContext,language,screenPath}} with the same length bounds as SessionStartRequest and a 5s deadline: the proxy currently calls build_vidya_voice_session with grade=None, subject=None, school_context=None, so re-landing it as-is would be a personalisation REGRESSION against the Developer-API path. Harden the client pump against binary frames, malformed JSON and disconnects.

queue.title: Deploy the sidecar to STAGING and prove the socket with negatives
queue.contract: cloudbuild.yaml defaults to _STAGING_SUFFIX=-staging, so the default deploy touches staging only and prod requires an explicit substitution we simply do not pass. The probe asserts four things and the three negatives matter more than the positive: valid token yields real audio bytes; a garbage token is rejected at handshake AND no stream_open appears in logs; a replayed token closes 4409; the seventh open in an hour closes 4429.

Add VIDYA_VOICE_LIVE_ALLOWED_UIDS: ten teachers is a canary, everyone is an experiment. mintStreamToken already exists and is byte-compatible with the Python verifier. queue.title: Flutter: rewire the Live client to the proxy, dual-shape tolerant
queue.contract: gemini_live_client.dart talks to the sidecar proxy. Fix _handleToolCall: it reads toolCall['functionCalls'], which the proxy never sends — Live would talk and never act, the exact regression the program doc calls unacceptable. Drop the client-side sendToolResponse (the sidecar already answers Vertex). Keep dual-shape parsing so a U1.5 rollback or a stale web revision degrades to the old path instead of bricking. Tests must pin connect()==false (never throws) for all five failure shapes, and _beginLive()==false so _begin() runs.
notes: Highest-consequence possible regression: Live failing silently AND turn-based not running means the app has no voice at all.
Contract-dependent on U1.3 but not deploy-dependent on U1.4 — write and test against the frame spec while the sidecar is still being hardened.
